title: Passive ballistic flight
description:
Uncontrolled flight with the gimbal locked at zero, from the 6 deg launch rail to landing under parachutes.

In wind the rocket weathercocks upwind during boost and then drifts downwind under the drogue and main chutes.

variants.label: No wind
variants.notes: Recovery: drogue at apogee (24 m/s), main at 300 m AGL (5.5 m/s), drifting with the wind.

variants.label: Wind 6 m/s from W
variants.notes: Recovery: drogue at apogee (24 m/s), main at 300 m AGL (5.5 m/s), drifting with the wind.
